work.headline: A complete MCQ evaluation ecosystem for Solicode.
work.description: SoliQuiz is a complete solution for managing MCQ evaluations, developed for the Solicode training center. It aims to digitize daily pedagogical feedback by offering a unified ecosystem for trainers and learners. The objective is to replace fragmented workflows with a single platform capable of tracing competency acquisition by micro-objective, automating correction, and providing granular performance analysis.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body: SoliQuiz is a complete solution for managing MCQ evaluations, developed for the Solicode training center. It aims to digitize daily pedagogical feedback by offering a unified ecosystem for trainers and learners. The objective is to replace fragmented workflows with a single platform capable of tracing competency acquisition by micro-objective, automating correction, and providing granular performance analysis.

sections.title: Architecture Overview
sections.body:
SoliQuiz is a robust Laravel 12 platform designed with a thin-controller / rich-service pattern. All business logic is encapsulated in App\Services, ensuring a scalable and maintainable codebase. The application serves two primary channels:

• Web Interface: Blade-based role-based dashboards for Admin, Trainer, and Students.
• RESTful API: A JSON provider secured by Laravel Sanctum for the mobile application ecosystem.

sections.title: Database & Entity Hierarchy
sections.body:
The relational data layer utilizes Eloquent ORM with a complex hierarchy:

• Pedagogical Structure: Seance → UniteApprentissage → Competence → QCM → Question → Option.
• User Management: Integrated with Spatie Laravel Permission for fine-grained RBAC (Admin, Formateur, Etudiant).
• Evaluation Logic: Attempts (Tentatives) track real-time scoring (0–100%) and granular performance per micro-objective.

sections.title: Service Layer & Security
sections.body: Security is enforced at multiple levels. The Web layer uses standard session-based auth with role-based routing, while the Mobile layer utilizes Laravel Sanctum for token-based API security. Dedicated services like PassationService manage complex lifecycles, including idempotent attempt starts to prevent duplicate entries.

sections.title: Frontend & Mobile Ecosystem
sections.body: The frontend is built on a modern stack of Tailwind CSS and Alpine.js for lightweight reactivity. The mobile version, SoliQuiz Mobile, is a hybrid application utilizing Tailwind CSS 4 and a centralized Alpine.js store for state management. It features a custom 'Ocean Teal' design system and is deployed as an Android APK via NativePHP.

sections.title: Academic Context
sections.body: Developed as a Project de Fin de Formation (PFE) at Solicode Tangier (2025/2026). The project followed a rigorous lifecycle: Design Thinking analysis, UI/UX Maquettage, and full technical documentation for both Web and Mobile platforms.

work.tagline: Luxury Real Estate Concierge & Wealth Management.
work.headline: A premium digital showcase for luxury real estate in Tangier.
work.description: Warden Properties is a premium digital showcase for a high-end real estate agency based in Tangier, Morocco. The platform is designed to provide a bespoke experience for luxury property owners and investors, embodying a 'Luminous' aesthetic that blends discretion with five-star hotel standards.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Warden Properties serves as a digital showcase for a high-end agency in Tangier. The platform targets owners for the rental management of luxury villas and riads, as well as investors seeking a curated portfolio. The design embodies the 'Luminous' aesthetic, combining technical rigor with luxury hotel standards.

sections.title: Features & Experience
sections.body:
• Multilingual Architecture: Full localization in four languages (FR, EN, AR, ES) with dedicated routing.
• Premium Design System: Use of glassmorphism, fluid scroll animations, and sophisticated typography.
• Mobile Optimization: A 'mobile-first' approach ensuring perfect fluidity across all devices.

sections.title: Technical Stack
sections.body:
• Core: Semantic HTML5 and Vanilla JavaScript.
• Style: Tailwind CSS for a responsive, utility-oriented system.
• Typography: Cormorant Garamond (Editorial Serif) and Inter (Sans-serif).
• Analytics: Integrated Vercel Web Analytics for performance tracking.

sections.title: SEO & Performance
sections.body: The site integrates advanced SEO with Schema.org LD+JSON (RealEstateAgent) for optimal ranking. Deployed on Vercel, it benefits from Clean URLs and ultra-fast loading times via a global CDN.
